description: This file defines the Logical class for boolean logical functions and conditionals within the PhpSpreadsheet library, including deprecated functions that delegate to newer implementations.

classes.name: Logical
classes.description: Provides deprecated static methods for logical functions, acting as wrappers to newer implementations within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: true
methods.description: Returns the boolean TRUE, delegating to Boolean::true().

methods.name: false
methods.description: Returns the boolean FALSE, delegating to Boolean::false().

methods.name: logicalAnd
methods.description: Returns the logical AND of provided arguments, delegating to Logical\Operations::logicalAnd().

methods.name: logicalOr
methods.description: Returns the logical OR of provided arguments, delegating to Logical\Operations::logicalOr().

methods.name: logicalXor
methods.description: Returns the logical XOR of provided arguments, delegating to Logical\Operations::logicalXor().

methods.name: NOT
methods.description: Returns the inverse of the provided logical value, delegating to Logical\Operations::NOT().

methods.name: statementIf
methods.description: Performs a conditional check, delegating to Logical\Conditional::statementIf().

methods.name: statementSwitch
methods.description: Returns a result based on matching value, delegating to Logical\Conditional::statementSwitch().

methods.name: IFERROR
methods.description: Returns the first value if no error, otherwise the second, delegating to Logical\Conditional::IFERROR().

methods.name: IFNA
methods.description: Returns the value if not an #N/A error, otherwise the alternate, delegating to Logical\Conditional::IFNA().

methods.name: IFS
methods.description: Evaluates multiple conditions and returns corresponding value, delegating to Logical\Conditional::IFS().
